claim: In the matching retail DLL, SaveData.get_story_work (0x06005171) is a static parameterless method with exact signature blob 0000129cd4 and an exact 39-byte body. It loads static field StoryWork.storyScenario (0x04004856), compares it against raw Int32 2 with bge, and when the comparison is not taken returns SaveData.inst.smSaveData[StoryWork.storyScenario]. When the comparison is taken it calls StorySaveDataManager.inst.GetStoryData() and returns that result. FACT-0099 pins the already-canonical caller at SaveData.get_story_data IL+0x0000.
